name: Adaire Blocks
author: Adaire Digital

sections.description:
Adaire Blocks is a WordPress plugin that provides custom Gutenberg blocks to create visually appealing websites. Built with modern web technologies including GSAP, React, and optimized for performance.

Available Blocks:

  • Accordion – Create collapsible content sections with smooth animations
  • Accordion Item – Custom block for enhanced functionality
  • Button – Create customizable buttons with hover animations
  • Video Player – Custom block for enhanced functionality
  • Icon Box – Custom block for enhanced functionality
  • Social Banner – Custom block for enhanced functionality
  • Testimonial – Showcase client testimonials with carousels
  • Posts Grid – Custom block for enhanced functionality
  • Posts Carousel – Custom block for enhanced functionality
  • Tabs – Custom block for enhanced functionality
  • Tab Panel – Custom block for enhanced functionality
  • Video – Custom block for enhanced functionality
  • Animation Scroll – Custom block for enhanced functionality
  • Content Toggle – Custom block for enhanced functionality
  • Content Toggle Panel – Custom block for enhanced functionality
  • Flipcard – Custom block for enhanced functionality
  • Flipcard Front – Custom block for enhanced functionality
  • Flipcard Back – Custom block for enhanced functionality
  • Swiper Carousel – Custom block for enhanced functionality
  • Swiper Slide – Custom block for enhanced functionality
  • Our Process – Custom block for enhanced functionality
  • Social Share – Custom block for enhanced functionality

Features:

  • Built with modern JavaScript (ES6+), React, and GSAP
  • Optimized for performance with efficient block registration
  • Compatible with WordPress 6.7+ and PHP 7.4+
  • Responsive design with mobile-first approach
  • GSAP-powered animations with scroll triggers
  • Smooth transitions and micro-interactions
  • GPL-3.0 licensed for maximum flexibility

Support

For support, please visit our website at https://adaire.digital/ or contact us through the WordPress.org support forums.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/adaire-blocks directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress
  3. Start using the custom blocks in the Gutenberg editor
sections.faq:
What WordPress version is required?

This plugin requires WordPress 6.7 or higher and PHP 7.4 or higher.

Are the blocks compatible with all themes?

The blocks are designed to work with most modern WordPress themes and can be customized through the block editor settings.

Can I customize the animations and styles?

Yes, all blocks include extensive customization options in the block editor, including colors, fonts, animation speeds, and layout settings.

Do the blocks work on mobile devices?

Yes, all blocks are fully responsive and optimized for mobile devices.
